testCase:
D-10: A meeting time in another time zone
Goal: Schedule a meeting on 12 November 2026 at 09:30 Tokyo time.
STEP 1: Navigate to /sandbox/d-10/
STEP 2: Select "12 November 2026" in "Date"
STEP 3: Select "09" in "Hour" and "30" in "Minute"
STEP 4: Select "Tokyo (UTC+09:00)" in "Time zone"
STEP 5: Click "Schedule meeting"
STEP 6: Verify "Meeting set: 12 November 2026 09:30 Tokyo (UTC+09:00), New York 11 November 2026 19:30" is visible

plan.title: D-10: Schedule a meeting in Tokyo time

steps.note: Interpret the selected time in Tokyo's time zone.

args.text: Meeting set: 12 November 2026 09:30 Tokyo (UTC+09:00), New York 11 November 2026 19:30

steps.note: Verify the scheduled Tokyo time and the previous-day New York conversion.

reasoning: This test checks that scheduling a meeting for 12 November 2026 at 09:30 Tokyo time displays the expected New York time. The plan selects the requested date, time, and time zone, then verifies the exact meeting confirmation.
